theme.designMd:
# Current Together AI visual reference (2026-09-28)

Use the current Together AI public homepage, not an unrelated AI dashboard. White and mist-blue canvas; black wordmark and text; airy, almost full-width sections with large vertical white space. The first desktop viewport has a narrow black announcement bar, a floating white navigation strip, left-aligned large black/gray two-line hero heading, small description and black/gray rectangular CTAs. On the right place the brand's distinctive intersecting translucent blue discs, purple rings and orange hexagon 3D assembly with tiny mono technical labels. A muted partner-logo marquee sits along the lower hero edge. Typography resembles The Future / The Future Mono: geometric modern sans for body/headings and very small mono uppercase labels. Below: centered Together AI Platform heading and three pastel blue/pink/peach metric blocks; wide Full-stack cloud tabbed product showcase with cyan active tab; dark navy research-carousel chapter; customer case-study cards; recent articles; clean CTA and dense footer with huge pale together.ai wordmark. Mobile hides the desktop 3D hero art, centers stacked heading and CTAs, uses a compact white header with black SIGN IN and hamburger, and stacks content vertically. Avoid purple cyberpunk, dark SaaS hero, invented model cards or fictional claims.

Reconstruct Together AI's official homepage to exact specifications from 2026-10-10:

1. Color scheme and typography:
- Hero has icy pale blue #edf6ff background, black 40px rotating announcement strip at the very top: "ThunderKittens v0.2 & NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 integration live | Read benchmarks -> | Together Platform Status: 100.0% Operational".
- Floating white rounded sticky header with black together.ai wordmark + colored three-circle glyph (blue, yellow, red circles). Nav links: Inference, Compute, Model Shaping, Research, Developers, Company, Pricing, Contact Sales, and black pill 'Sign In'.
- Font: Geist / Neue Montreal geometric rounded sans, uppercase mono accent badges and buttons.

2. Hero section:
- Left aligned at x43: Black first line "Build what's next" and gray second line "on the AI Native Cloud".
- Paragraph: "Full-stack AI platform, powered by cutting-edge research. Deploy open and custom models at sub-millisecond latencies on premier silicon."
- CTA buttons: Black uppercase mono "START BUILDING" and pale border "CONTACT SALES".
- Right side: Original translucent blue circle / intersecting violet-blue disks / orange hexagon abstract geometric diagram art preserved.
- Trusted By ticker / wordmark strip: Moving/flowing gray wordmarks: Cognition, Cursor, ElevenLabs, SK telecom, Mozilla, NOUS, Salesforce, DeepMind, Quora, The Washington Post, Zoom.

3. Section 1: The Together AI Platform
- Centered title "The Together AI Platform" with centered subtitle: "Powering every step of the AI development journey —from experimentation to massive scale."
- Wide tabs: Inference (pale cyan active pill/tab #e0f2fe text-sky-900 font-semibold), Compute, Model shaping.
- Under it, white rounded split panel:
  * Left: Exact five rows with "Serverless Inference" expanded:
    "The fastest way to run open-source models on demand. Powered by cutting-edge inference research. No infrastructure to manage, no long-term commitments. Learn more ->"
    Followed by Batch Inference, Provisioned Throughput, Dedicated Model Inference, Dedicated Container Inference.
  * Right: MiniMax M2.7 FP4 dashboard + terminal code snippet on cyan/pink subtle gradient background, highlighting low-latency endpoint, tokens/sec, and FP4 quantization benchmarks.
  * Note: Remove old three-metric cards (FASTER INFERENCE 2x / LOWER COST / FASTER PRE-TRAINING) or separate redundant full-stack blocks to strictly reflect the requested single streamlined panel structure.

4. Section 2: Deep Navy (#03021e) Research section:
- Headline: "Grounded in cutting-edge research", subtitle: "Foundational systems research for production AI."
- Top right: Arrow controls (< >) and "View all publications ->"
- Four dark-violet / midnight-blue thin rectangular research cards with tags:
  1) [KERNELS & HARDWARE] Sep 2026: "To Infinity and Beyond: ThunderKittens Now on NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72!" (Porting our bare-metal tile programming model to next-generation GPU hardware...)
  2) [AGENTIC INFERENCE] Aug 2026: "ThunderAgent: 2x Faster Agentic Inference for Synthetic Data Generation at Scale" (Pipelined speculative decoding coupled with multi-branch tree verification...)
  3) [CONFERENCE HIGHLIGHT / ICML 2026] "Together AI at ICML 2026: frontier research across the full stack" (9 accepted papers across memory optimization, non-causal speculative decoding...)
  4) [BENCHMARK LAB] Jul 2026: "ParallelKernelBench: Frontier LLMs can't write fast multi-GPU kernels (yet)" (Comprehensive evaluation of 14 leading models attempting CUDA, Triton, and ThunderKittens...)

5. Section 3: "AI natives build on Together AI"
- Subtitle: "See how Together AI powers customers building the next generation of AI products."
- Three dark cards:
  1) Cursor: "12ms" Median speculative latency — "Together AI's custom speculative engine powers Cursor's instant tab autocompletion across millions of developers every single day." (Aman Sanger, Co-founder)
  2) Decagon: "6x" Cost reduction per turn vs. gpt-5 mini — "Deploying dedicated fine-tuned models on Together AI allowed us to scale autonomous customer service for Fortune 500 enterprises." (Jesse Zhang, CEO)
  3) Vercept: "11x" Faster Inference — "Switching from legacy hyperscaler endpoints to Together Dedicated GPU instances immediately reduced our monthly token burn and slashed latency." (Elena Rostova, CTO)

6. Section 4: "What's new at Together AI"
- Main featured card: "Together Link: frontier-quality open models in the harness you already use" (Infrastructure Essay • Oct 2026).
- Secondary cards:
  1) "The Open Source AI Stack: Architecting Independent Frontier Intelligence"
  2) "Together AI and Y Combinator partner to launch the first dedicated GPU cluster for the YC community"
  3) "GLM-5.3 vs. Claude Fable 5 on DeepSWE: Cost, Coding, and Routing"
- Link: "Explore all blog posts ->"

7. Section 5: "Start building on Together AI"
- Subtitle: "From optimized training and model shaping to large-scale production inference"
- Buttons: Black mono "GET STARTED NOW" and pale "SCHEDULE ARCHITECTURE REVIEW"

8. Complete Footer:
- Columns: Products (Serverless Inference, Dedicated Endpoints, Batch API, GPU Clusters, Fine-tuning Platform, ThunderKittens Kernels), Models & Hardware (Llama 3.3 Suite, DeepSeek V3.2 & R1, Qwen 2.5 72B, Flux.1 Schnell, NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, NVIDIA H200 SXM), Developers & Lab (Documentation, Python SDK, TypeScript SDK, Research Papers, Community Discord, Status Dashboard), Company (About Us, Careers, News & Press, Security & Trust, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service).
- System status indicator: "All systems operational"
- Large watermark logo Together.ai and copyright 2026.
